name: faceguard
description: FaceGuard — consent-based 'find my own face online' monitoring service

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.start: npm run setup && npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace apps/api run build && npm --workspace apps/web run build
